entry.title: Inside: Phone Check 1.18.0
entry.summary:
New AirPods & headphones check: left and right channels, the headphone microphone, head tracking and surround sound, added to your check report. Screen check: tap anywhere for the next color. A simpler benchmark page: every quick test in one list, each with its own run button.
新增 AirPods 與耳機檢查：左右聲道、耳機麥克風錄音回放、頭部追蹤與環繞音，結果附在健檢報告。 螢幕檢查：點畫面任何地方就換下一個顏色。 效能跑分頁更精簡：所有快速測試整合成一張清單，每項都能單獨重測。

entry.title: Tuck: AI Screenshot Organizer 3.3.2
entry.summary:
Tuck 3.3.2: a whole year of receipts at once. The receipts list now exports a full year as a CSV plus one PDF of the originals, ready for taxes. Settings also lists our other apps.
收好 3.3.2：年底報帳更省事 • 收據頁可一次匯出整年：CSV 試算表加收據原檔 PDF • 設定頁底部可看看我們的其他 App

entry.title: Roomory: Floor Plans 2.3.1
entry.summary:
Roomory 2.3.1 • More apps: our other apps, in the ••• menu on the projects list • Roomory Pro states price, period and how to cancel right beside Subscribe • Fixes and polish
居圖 2.3.1 • 更多 App：專案列表的「•••」選單可看到我們的其他 App • Roomory Pro 訂閱按鈕旁直接寫明價格、週期與取消方式 • 細部修正與改善

entry.title: Nightvane: Star Guide 1.2.0
entry.summary:
• Observation log: collect the Moon and planets, 110 Messier objects and 88 constellations • Game Center leaderboard of objects found by pointing at the real sky • Share a card of anything you found • Camera view: see the stars over the live camera picture • Lock-screen and Dynamic Island countdown to space station passes, a meteor shower's best hour and eclipses • Tonight's cloud cover and the clearest night of the week, from Apple Weather
• 觀測紀錄：收集月亮與行星、110 個梅西耶天體與 88 個星座 • Game Center 排行榜：比比看誰對準實際天空找到最多天體 • 把找到的天體做成卡片分享 • 相機模式：星星疊在相機即時畫面上 • 太空站過境、流星雨最佳時刻與月食在鎖定畫面與動態島倒數 • 今晚雲量與一週內最晴的夜晚（Apple 天氣）

entry.title: Lockwater: Canal Puzzle 1.1.0
entry.summary:
Daily level: tap the sun on the home screen for a new puzzle every day. Solving it gives a hint, and every seventh day in a row gives three.
Chapters 11 and 12: 20 new, harder levels, before dawn and at sunrise.
Two new achievements for daily levels.
The gear menu now has More Games & Apps, which opens our other games and apps on the App Store.
每日一關：點首頁的太陽，每天一道新謎題。過關送 1 個提示，每連續滿 7 天的那天送 3 個。
第 11、12 章：20 個更難的新關卡，從黎明前到日出。
新增兩個每日一關成就。
齒輪選單新增「更多作品」，可在 App Store 看我們的其他遊戲與 App。

entry.title: Daikon: Period Tracker 1.6.0
entry.summary:
A heads-up from your diary: when a symptom you log keeps coming back at the same point of your cycle, Today tells you the day before. Your history now charts your recent cycle lengths against your usual range. New restock reminder: a nudge to buy pads, tampons or cups, 1 to 10 days ahead. Settings lists our other apps at the bottom.
日記幫你預告：記下的症狀如果總在週期的同一時間出現，今天頁會提前一天提醒你。 「你的記錄」新增圖表，看最近的週期長度與平常範圍。 新增生理用品提醒：提前 1 到 10 天提醒你補充衛生棉、棉條或月亮杯。 設定頁底部可以找到我們的其他 App。

entry.title: ZaiRi: Plant Watering Reminder 1.3.1
entry.summary:
A small refinement to what happens after you finish a care task.
小幅調整完成照護後的流程。

entry.title: Prawnlight: Prawn Hall Tycoon 1.0.1
entry.summary:
Safer saves: if the app is closed while saving, the next launch no longer starts a new game, and leaving before your first hall opens starts you over at the title.
On a monthly card's last day, the check-in card shows that day's diamonds.
The hall, guests, interface and sounds no longer rebuild every frame, for smoother play.
Ads are now requested as non-personalized only.
Translation fixes in German, Spanish, French, Japanese and English.
存檔更安全：存檔途中 App 被關掉，下次開啟不會再變成新遊戲；還沒開店前離開，下次會回到標題畫面。
最後一天的月卡會在簽到卡上顯示當天的鑽石。
大廳、客人、介面與音效不再每幀重建，畫面更順。
廣告改為只請求非個人化廣告。
修正德文、西班牙文、法文、日文與英文的部分翻譯。

entry.title: Precision Parking 3D 1.0.2
entry.summary:
Improves save recovery when storage is full, adds VoiceOver labels and fixes several display issues.
改善儲存空間不足時的存檔復原，新增 VoiceOver 標籤，並修正部分畫面顯示問題。
